description: This Java class 'GenericPdu' models a Protocol Data Unit (PDU) used in the MMS protocol, providing methods to access and modify its headers such as message type, MMS version, and sender information.

classes.name: GenericPdu
classes.description: A class representing a generic MMS Protocol Data Unit with headers management.

methods.name: GenericPdu
methods.description: Default constructor initializing a new instance with empty headers.

methods.name: GenericPdu(PduHeaders headers)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the instance with provided headers.

methods.name: getPduHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with this PDU.

methods.name: getMessageType
methods.description: Retrieves the message type header value.

methods.name: setMessageType
methods.description: Sets the message type header value, throws InvalidHeaderValueException if invalid.

methods.name: getMmsVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the MMS version header value.

methods.name: setMmsVersion
methods.description: Sets the MMS version header value, throws InvalidHeaderValueException if invalid.
